subject.title: Add gated Claw publication and validation

question: Should ClawHub adopt this `family: "claw"` persistent package contract and staged four-PR rollout while the Claws RFC remains open?
rationale: The branch creates a stored family, manifest schema, dependencies, CLI surface, and deployment flag; implementation review cannot determine whether that experimental design should become a supported ClawHub contract.

options.title: Approve staged adoption
options.body: Accept the proposed contract, require live lifecycle proof, and merge the stack in dependency order with the deployment flag off.

options.title: Revise the contract
options.body: Keep the stack open while maintainers narrow or change its manifest, storage, API, or rollout model through the RFC.

options.title: Pause implementation
options.body: Defer the implementation stack until the RFC has explicit sponsorship and a clear product owner.

recommendation.title: Approve staged adoption
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed contract, require live lifecycle proof, and merge the stack in dependency order with the deployment flag off.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available current-main history is recent package insertion security and visibility work in the backend this PR extends.
